status: CANDIDATE ONLY; repository and index unchanged

availability_prose_changes.before:
These files are prepared locally for the official iGEM GitLab repository. Local
preparation does not publish them or deploy the team Wiki. The current source
and download hashes are recorded in `code/aerosense/source-manifest.json`.
availability_prose_changes.after: These documents use byte-verified official iGEM CDN download links. Their original bytes remain in the canonical archive; they are not bundled into the competition source-only repository. Source and download hashes are recorded in `code/aerosense/source-manifest.json`.

availability_prose_changes.before:
The documents retain their original bytes. Website downloads should use the
verified official publication URL once available, rather than embedding Drive.
availability_prose_changes.after: The linked documents retain their original bytes and use the verified official publication URLs.

availability_prose_changes.before: The local website keeps a byte-identical PDF display copy because GitLab raw responses prohibit cross-origin embedding; its open/download links use these published files.
availability_prose_changes.after: PDF open/download links use verified official CDN copies. Entries labelled archive status are preserved artifacts without an established public download.
